pattern: Time Relative Words (어제 / 오늘 / 내일 / 지금)
meaningEn: Basic time anchor words (Yesterday / Today / Tomorrow / Now).
meaningId: Kata acuan waktu dasar (Kemarin / Hari ini / Besok / Sekarang).

notesEn.formation: Standalone time adverbs placed before verbs or at the start of sentences.
notesEn.usage: Establishes the time frame of a sentence.
notesEn.nuance: Remember that relative time adverbs like 어제, 오늘, 내일, and 지금 do NOT take the time particle ~에.

notesId.formation: Kata keterangan waktu mandiri yang diletakkan sebelum kata kerja atau di awal kalimat.
notesId.usage: Menentukan kerangka waktu dari suatu kalimat.
notesId.nuance: Ingat bahwa kata keterangan waktu relatif seperti 어제, 오늘, 내일, dan 지금 TIDAK menggunakan partikel waktu ~에.

examples.meaningId: Apa yang kamu lakukan hari ini?

quiz.question: Which time word correctly fills the blank for 'I studied yesterday'? -> ___ 공부했어요.
quiz.explanationEn: 공부했어요 is in the past tense, so '어제' (yesterday) fits logically.
quiz.explanationId: 공부했어요 dalam bentuk lampau, jadi '어제' (kemarin) cocok secara logis.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'What are you doing today?'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Apa yang kamu lakukan hari ini?'

pattern: Time Noun + 동안 (Duration / For a period)
meaningEn: Expressing duration ('for / during a time period').

notesEn.usage: Indicates the total length of time during which an action or state occurs.
notesEn.nuance: Can be attached to time quantities (3시간 동안 = for 3 hours) or nouns representing periods (방학 동안 = during vacation).

notesId.usage: Menunjukkan total jangka waktu di mana suatu tindakan atau keadaan terjadi.
notesId.nuance: Dapat ditempelkan pada kuantitas waktu (3시간 동안 = selama 3 jam) atau kata benda yang mewakili periode (방학 동안 = selama liburan).

examples.meaningEn: I will go traveling during vacation.
How long (for how much time) were you in Korea?
examples.meaningId: Berapa lama kamu berada di Korea?

quiz.question: How do you say 'for two hours' in Korean?
quiz.explanationEn: 시간 denotes duration/hours, combined with 동안 (두 시간 동안). 시 alone denotes a specific time on the clock.
quiz.explanationId: 시간 menunjukkan durasi/jam, digabungkan dengan 동안 (두 시간 동안). 시 saja menunjukkan jam spesifik pada jam.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I studied for two hours. -> 두 시간 ___ 공부했어요.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I studied for two hours.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya belajar selama dua jam.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use two hours (두 시간) + duration particle 동안 + studied (공부했어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan dua jam (두 시간) + partikel durasi 동안 + belajar lampau (공부했어요).

notesEn.formation: Start Time + 부터 + End Time + 까지.
notesEn.usage: Specifies starting and ending points for time durations.
notesEn.nuance: When marking locations, use 에서 ~ 까지 instead of 부터 ~ 까지.

notesId.formation: Waktu Mulai + 부터 + Waktu Selesai + 까지.
notesId.usage: Menentukan titik awal dan akhir untuk durasi waktu.
notesId.nuance: Ketika menandai lokasi, gunakan 에서 ~ 까지 sebagai ganti 부터 ~ 까지.

examples.meaningEn: I work from 9 o'clock to 5 o'clock.
examples.meaningId: Saya bekerja dari jam 9 sampai jam 5.

examples.meaningEn: There are classes from Monday to Friday.
examples.meaningId: Ada kelas dari hari Senin sampai Jumat.

examples.meaningEn: Since when did you learn Korean?
examples.meaningId: Sejak kapan kamu belajar bahasa Korea?

quiz.question: Which particle pair indicates 'from (time) to (time)'?
quiz.explanationEn: 부터 is used for starting time, and 까지 is used for ending time/limit.
quiz.explanationId: 부터 digunakan untuk waktu mulai, dan 까지 digunakan untuk waktu selesai/batas.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I work from 9 o'clock to 5 o'clock. -> 9시___ 5시까지 일해요.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'I work from 9 o'clock to 5 o'clock.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Saya bekerja dari jam 9 sampai jam 5.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use 9 o'clock from (9시부터) + 5 o'clock to (5시까지) + work (일해요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan jam 9 dari (9시부터) + jam 5 sampai (5시까지) + bekerja (일해요).
